capabilities: Display a breadcrumb bar of folder, file, and current heading chain
Follow the cursor in edit mode or the scroll position in reading mode
Jump to headings via a sibling-heading menu or right-click
Reveal files and folders in the file explorer from folder/file crumbs
Configure anchor position, truncation length, and tab-header rendering
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not related to or derived from the Breadcrumbs plugin; it only shows a trail for the currently open file, not a parent/child note hierarchy.
extras: The author states the plugin was written with AI assistance and provides no correctness guarantee; requires Obsidian 1.13.0+ on desktop only. Translations are AI-generated and unreviewed.
problem: Obsidian has no persistent breadcrumb trail showing where you are in a note's heading hierarchy; you must open the Outline pane or scroll to orient yourself.
summary: VS Code-style breadcrumb bar at the top of the editor showing folder, file, and current heading chain, following the cursor or scroll position.
